title: Chicken Parmigiana Australian Style
description: Chicken Parmigiana Australian Style is a dish from Australia featuring chicken breast, all-purpose flour, chicken egg, breadcrumbs. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Pat dry, then coat evenly with the listed breading or flour components; press lightly to help it adhere.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 15 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 20 minutes until set and cooked through.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
